title: Syman
summary:
SYMAN is an artificial intelligence technology that uses data from social media profiles to identify trends in the job market. SYMAN is designed to organize actionable data for products and services including recruiting, human capital management, CRM, and marketing.

SYMAN was developed by a company called Identified, with an inception and publication date of 2013. The technology applies AI techniques to analyze social media data to extract useful patterns and insights for workforce analytics and talent management applications.
